2609.09899.title: Strangers to Themselves: What Language Models Say About Themselves Is Generic
2609.09899.paper_summary: Language models can fluently describe how they would behave: whether they would cave to pushback, misuse a tool, or lie under pressure. Is that description actually about the model speaking? We turn self-knowledge into a prediction test. Across nine behavioral evaluations, we measure how a model behaves under different conditions, ask it to predict those rates, and compare its predictions with controls that remove the self from the question. We find that: (i) Direct self-report is weak (r = +0.04), and even showing the model the exact items only raises prediction to +0.24. Crucially, the same item-informed question about "capable AI agents in general" does just as well (+0.28), while other models' answers about themselves predict the target model at least as well as its own. (ii) Frontier scale does not detectably change this pattern: any gains in prediction are not self-specific, and are consistent with a better theory of how AI assistants behave rather than better self-knowledge. (iii) First-person framing does have one robust effect: it shifts reports in the flattering direction, understating harmful behavior relative to the same question about a generic agent. (iv) Finetuning on a model's own behavioral record can teach narrow self-predictions, but it also changes the behavior being predicted and the gains do not transfer broadly. The practical implication is simple: asking a model what it would do mostly reveals a theory of AI assistants in general, plus a favorable bias, rather than privileged knowledge of that model.
2609.09899.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型可以流利地描述它們會如何行為：無論是會屈服於反對意見、誤用工具，還是會在壓力下撒謊。這種描述實際上是關於說話的模型嗎？我們將自我認知轉化為預測測試。在九項行為評估中，我們測量模型在不同條件下的行為，要求它預測這些比率，並將其預測與去除自我後的控制組進行比較。我們發現：（i）直接自我報告是微弱的（r = +0.04），即使向模型展示確切的項目，預測也僅提高到 +0.24。關鍵是，關於「一般有能力的 AI 代理」的相同項目知情問題表現得同樣好（+0.28），而其他模型對自身的回答預測目標模型的效果至少和它自己的回答一樣好。（ii）前沿規模並未可察覺地改變這一模式：預測的任何增益並非特定於自我，且與更好的 AI 助手行為理論一致，而非更好的自我認知。（iii）第一人稱框架確實有一個穩健的效果：它使報告朝著有利的方向轉變，相較於關於一般代理的相同問題，低估了有害行為。（iv）對模型自身行為記錄的微調可以教會狹隘的自我預測，但它也改變了被預測的行為，且增益並未廣泛轉移。實際的含義很簡單：詢問模型它會怎麼做主要揭示了一個關於 AI 助手的一般理論，加上一個有利的偏見，而不是對該模型的特權知識。
2609.09899.author: Phil Blandfort et.al.
